narrative.overview:
Ventura looks like a well-kept ledger on a white desk: cool paper, hairline rules, figures that line up in columns, and one blue pen used only to act. It is the category standard played straight, held to the craft bar of Linear and Mercury. The interface itself is the proof, so marketing pages lead with the real product at work on labelled example data rather than abstract charts or illustration. Nothing glows, nothing is tilted, and no surface competes with the evidence.

Density follows the reader. Marketing pages are generous and quiet: a left-aligned semi-expanded headline, a short subline, then wide product frames and hairline lists with long vertical rhythm. The signed-in app is compact and calm: a 14px base, 32px navigation rows, 36px buttons, white cards on a faintly blue-grey canvas. Colour carries meaning, never mood. Ultramarine means "you can act here". The severity hues mean "this finding needs attention". Everything else is cool neutral.

The system refuses the generic AI-startup register (gradients, glow, "AI-powered" sparkle) and anything playful. Depth comes from hairlines and tonal steps first, with soft ink-tinted shadows reserved for raised product frames and floating layers. Motion is one authored entrance and quick, quiet state changes.
keyCharacteristics: An ultramarine field owns whole regions on marketing pages; the home hero carries a live ledger scan as its signature.
Light, cool canvas with blue-tinted neutrals running to a near-black blue ink.
One ultramarine accent, reserved for actions, links, focus and selection.
Archivo throughout; display sizes run semi-expanded on the font's width axis to echo the extended wordmark.
Hairline lists and ruled tables in place of grids of identical cards.
Product visuals are the real components on labelled example data.
Two weights (400 and 500), sentence case everywhere, tabular figures for every amount.
One deep-ink band per marketing page, carrying the "a person decides" story.

rules.name: The One Ultramarine Rule
rules.body: Ultramarine marks what you can act on: buttons, links, focus, selection, and the Open status (an open finding is waiting for your action). It is never a chart series, a decoration or a heading colour. Charts use Azure precisely so the accent stays unambiguous.

rules.name: The Findings-Only Rule
rules.body: Red, orange, amber and slate belong to findings: severity chips and dots, flagged evidence rows, and the marks that show why a finding fired. Outcome green belongs to decisions. No other surface borrows these hues for emphasis.

rules.name: The Status Is Not Severity Rule
rules.body: Review status never reuses severity colour. Open wears the ultramarine tint, Resolved wears outcome green, Dismissed is neutral grey. An open Low finding must never read as red.

rules.name: The Width Is the Voice Rule
rules.body: Only marketing, auth and error headlines take the semi-expanded width. Everything inside the product, including app page titles, stays at normal width.

rules.name: The Two Weights Rule
rules.body: Regular (400) reads and medium (500) leads. Headlines are medium, never bold. Semibold (600) is allowed only at glyph scale: avatar initials at 11px and chart callouts at 12px.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Headings, buttons, nav items, labels and chips are written in sentence case. There are no uppercase, letter-spaced micro-labels anywhere.

rules.name: The Mono Means Machine Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is for strings a system generated (ANO-0142, an invite code, an event name). Amounts, dates and prose stay in Archivo with tabular figures.

rules.name: The Columns Line Up Rule
rules.body: Every amount, count and table cell uses tabular figures; amounts right-align in tables.

rules.name: The Hairline List Rule
rules.body: On marketing pages, a set of parallel items (checks, practices, values, principles) is a ruled list of title-and-body rows on hairlines, never a grid of identical cards. Two-column variants keep the same rule lines.

rules.name: The One Ink Band Rule
rules.body: A marketing page carries at most one Deep Ink band, and it tells the human-decision story (home: "Ventura recommends. Your team decides."; demo: the record of decisions). The login page's brand panel is its one ink surface. Inside the app, ink appears only as small marks (the workspace monogram) and the drawer scrim.

rules.name: The Example Data Rule
rules.body: Every product visual on a public page carries the words "Example data" in its header, right-aligned in muted text (a dashed-outline tag on the hero frame). Nothing on the site implies real customers or results.

rules.name: The Hairline First Rule
rules.body: Separate with a rule or a tonal step before reaching for a shadow. A shadow without a hairline beside it is the exception.

rules.name: The One Frame Rule
rules.body: The large frame shadow belongs to the single product frame that leads a page. Supporting figures use the raised card shadow.

rules.name: The Frosted Bar Rule
rules.body: Sticky bars (the app top bar, the demo step rail) are 95% white with a light backdrop blur, so content passing beneath stays faintly legible without a heavy edge.

rules.name: The Field Rule
rules.text: The brand colour appears at scale or not at all: as the ultramarine field owning a whole region (hero, intro, closing band), or as an action. A marketing page opens on the field and closes on it; the app stays on paper.

dos: **Do** reserve ultramarine (`accent-500` to `accent-700`) for buttons, links, focus rings, selection and the Open status.
**Do** keep severity colour on findings only, and keep review status visibly separate from severity.
**Do** set marketing, auth and error headlines in Archivo at width 112 and weight 500, left-aligned, with tight negative tracking (-0.025em to -0.035em).
**Do** write every heading, button, nav item and label in sentence case.
**Do** use tabular figures for every amount and right-align amounts in tables.
**Do** separate surfaces with 1px hairlines and tonal steps first; use the card, card raised, frame and pop shadows by role.
**Do** label every product visual on a public page "Example data".
**Do** present parallel marketing content as a hairline list of title-and-body rows.
**Do** give each marketing page at most one Deep Ink band, used for the human-decision story.
**Do** keep state transitions short (140ms colour changes, 220ms pane swaps) on the expo ease-out, and respect reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** use ultramarine for chart series, headings, decorative fills or emphasis; charts use Azure and Teal Green.
**Don't** colour an Open finding red, or borrow severity hues for status, banners or general warnings.
**Don't** add coloured side borders to cards, rows or alerts; tint the whole row or use a dot.
**Don't** set uppercase, letter-spaced micro-labels or eyebrows above headlines.
**Don't** set amounts, dates or prose in mono.
**Don't** build marketing sections from grids of identical icon cards.
**Don't** put gradients, glow or neon on surfaces, buttons, text or backgrounds.
**Don't** show customer logos, testimonials, results or unlabelled product data.
**Don't** use Tailwind's default palette colours or default shadows; every colour and shadow comes from the tokens above.
